page.notes: The text runs on at the foot, so the paragraph is cut off and continues on the next page. Some words are doubtful: "tèplis" (probably templis) and "tôties" (the word is split across a line end; the reading is uncertain). "publicassFet" appears to be a printing error for publicasset, and the scan is unclear there. The initial mark at the start of "At" and the small slash beside "enim" are printer's marks or stains and are not transcribed.
